title_fb: 3 money mistakes on GTA 6 launch day
hook: Three money mistakes on G T A six launch day.
open_loop: Hook promises three mistakes; Benny makes them in order. Mistake three (fake key sites spreading malware) is held to the last story beat, then the A/B closes.
payoff: Three traps: $20 (25%) extra for Ultimate, 47% of pay-later users paid late, dozens of fake sites spreading malware.

lines.text: Three money mistakes on G T A 6 launch day.
lines.say: Three money mistakes on G T A six launch day.
lines.visual: SCENE 1 (frame 0): Benny in hoodie, backwards cap and gold shades in a launch-day line, excited, arms up. Headline '3 MISTAKES' already on screen, badge 'LAUNCH DAY'. Plain-text 'GTA 6' sign on a generic store front. Snap-zoom on 'Three'.

lines.text: First, Benny buys the Ultimate edition.
lines.visual: SCENE 2: Row '1' pops. Benny hands over cash at a counter, smug, flexing. Two plain generic boxes on the counter, one marked 'STANDARD', one bigger marked 'ULTIMATE' with a gold ribbon (no art, no logo).

lines.say: It costs twenty dollars, or twenty-five percent, more.
lines.visual: SCENE 3: Counter animates to +$20, then badge '+25%' stamps on. Benny's wallet coughs out cash, his smirk wobbles. Badge 'NOT FINANCIAL ADVICE' small at the bottom of the screen area.

lines.text: Second, he uses buy now, pay later.
lines.visual: SCENE 4: Row '2' pops. Benny taps a phone happily, 'FOUR EASY PAYMENTS' becomes a sticker; a bill calendar page hops up behind him. Benny winks, unaware.

lines.text: LendingTree found 47% of users paid late last year.
lines.say: LendingTree found forty-seven percent of users paid late last year.
lines.visual: SCENE 5 (on 'forty-seven'): snap-zoom, counter counts up to 47%, badge 'PAID LATE' slams down. SCENE 6 (on 'paid late'): alarm clocks and bill papers rain on Benny, he flinches, thud sfx. Beat: his grin freezes.

lines.text: Third, Benny buys a cheap key online.
lines.visual: SCENE 7: Row '3' pops. Benny in a dark room clicks a generic shady storefront labelled 'CHEAP KEY', drooling, hooded stranger peeks from the screen edge, sly grin.

lines.text: NordVPN found dozens of fake sites that spread malware.
lines.say: NordVPN found dozens of fake sites that spread malware.
lines.visual: SCENE 8 (on 'dozens'): many tiny identical fake-site windows pop up in a grid, red skull-bug icons crawl out of them onto Benny's screen. Headline 'DOZENS OF FAKE SITES'. SCENE 9 (on 'malware'): Benny shocked, buried in bugs, stamp 'MALWARE'.

lines.text: Ultimate, or Standard and keep the $20? Comment A or B.
lines.say: Ultimate, or Standard and keep the twenty? Comment A or B.
lines.visual: SCENE 10 (on 'Ultimate'): Benny smug, row 'A: ULTIMATE'. SCENE 11 (on 'Standard'): Benny holding twenty dollars cash, happy, row 'B: STANDARD +$20'. Benny points at viewer on 'Comment'. Small text 'NOT FINANCIAL ADVICE' stays.

facts_used.claim: Standard $79.99, Ultimate $99.99; difference $20.00 (25.0% more); Ultimate adds in-game extras.
LendingTree 2026 survey: 47% of buy-now-pay-later users paid late in the past year (general BNPL fact, not about GTA 6 buyers).
NordVPN found dozens of malicious sites impersonating Rockstar/game storefronts (fake pre-orders, malware installers).

math_check: 99.99-79.99=20.00; 20.00/79.99=25.00% (25%). LendingTree 47% quoted as is. NordVPN 'dozens' no number.

Number three could wreck your computer, not just your wallet.
Ultimate, or Standard and keep the $20? Comment A or B.
Ultimate costs $20 more than Standard, which is 25% more, for in-game extras. A LendingTree survey found 47% of buy-now-pay-later users paid late last year. NordVPN found dozens of fake game sites that spread malware.
Not financial advice. Sources: LendingTree, NordVPN via CyberInsider.
